verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party published tokens-per-second figures, latency benchmarks, or load-testing guides. The only number is an informal 300 tok/s remark in an HN thread (cerebras-comm-6), not published benchmark documentation. The Prometheus latency metrics for dedicated endpoints are a monitoring feature for your own traffic, an adjacent control that does not back the provider's speed claims.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can see published tokens-per-second or latency numbers, benchmarks, or load-testing guides backing the provider's speed claims
